channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyronn Lue | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyronn Lue from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Keaton Wagler on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Law Murray:Keaton Wagler on Tyronn Lue:

“He's one of the most chill coaches I've ever been around. It's kind of crazy”

Keaton Wagler on Tyronn Lue, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Jay Larranaga on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Jay Larranaga on Tyronn Lue:

“I think everyone on our staff is so blessed to have Ty as our boss, right? So, that's the first thing. And that appreciation for kind of how he treats everybody on a day-to-day basis, how he treats our staff, how he treats the players... You know, someone said a long time ago, like, he treats them so well that they almost feel guilty not to give an honest effort. And that's kind of what I try and do is like I'm gonna try and treat them really well, I'm going to try and give them everything possible to help them be successful. And then hopefully they take that lead.”

Jay Larranaga on Tyronn Lue, Jul 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Lawrence Frank, on Tyronn Lue’s future with the Clippers:

“Ty not being the coach was never, ever, ever a consideration. Even at our lowest point when were 6-21, there never, ever was any conversation of Ty not being the coach. Ty’s gonna be the coach here for a long, long time.”

Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue, Apr 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Law Murray:Lawrence Frank:

“T. Lue is gonna be here a long, long time. And when we had the presser after when we were talking about the CP decision, and there were questions... no. Through the good and the bad. We're gonna work through all this together, and he's been a great partner.”

Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue, Feb 9, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“Like I told [Lue], I would rather play another game than go out there and risk it,”

Kawhi Leonard on Tyronn Lue, Dec 29, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Norman Powell on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Powell:

“I think after I talked to T-Lue about what I wanted in terms of an extension and what I was looking for, I don’t know if that changed the course of things or whatever it was. But right around the time where smoke was in the air about teams’ interest and being traded, that’s kind of when the conversation shifted into ‘Oh, we got to get younger. We’re looking at that. A lot of the stuff that we have to deal with isn’t your fault in what you’re doing. Whatever, whatever.’ But the conversation kind of changed to ‘we love you for an extension to we got to figure out what the future looks like.’”

Norman Powell on Tyronn Lue, Nov 3, 2025. Source: Essentially Sports.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Mike Brown, Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“I ain’t never really heard too many people like Mike Brown — I ain’t saying they don’t, I just never heard nobody sing high praises for Mike Brown. “I never heard Bron say anything like Mike Brown is unbelievable. I mean, I never really heard Mike. He talked about Ty, Tyronn Lue. Yeah, that’s the only coach I ever heard him talk about.”

Jeff Teague on Mike Brown, Tyronn Lue, Jul 6, 2025. Source: Pro Football Network.

item.title: Kai Jones on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“T (Coach Tyronn Lue) told me when I got here, that everything that I did in the past (I needed to) forgive myself, you know, just learn from it, grow from it and just be better,”

Kai Jones on Tyronn Lue, Oct 14, 2024. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Jeff Van Gundy on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“People always ask me, ‘Are you sure you want to do it?’ You’re never sure until you do it. I’m sure I want to help, and I want to work, and I want to do it in basketball…I’m excited to go out there in any way (Ty Lue) deems fit, and fit in with his staff and try to help the Clippers achieve what they want to, which is win big and be a championship-level contender.”

Jeff Van Gundy on Tyronn Lue, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
L Frank on Tyronn Lue:

“I think Ty had a terrific year, our hope is that Ty is the coach of the LA Clippers for a long time... one of the elite coaches in today's game... great way of connecting... truth teller without leaving scars and wounds”

Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Ty Lue:

“He in particular is very, very good as a game manager. He really picks scabs when it comes to matchups and weaknesses on the other team and he'll identify that very quickly and make you feel very vulnerable with the way that he calls the game.”

Mark Daigneault on Tyronn Lue, Dec 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: James Harden on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“They just allow me to get creative and read the defenses and see what they’re doing on the defensive floor, and every game is different to where [Lue] sees something and I’m allowed to sit back and do it,”

James Harden on Tyronn Lue, Nov 22, 2023. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Lawrence Frank:

“We love T. Lue. We want T. Lue to be coach here for a long time. He's one of the elite coaches in this league, and there's always a timing for things like that.”

Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Serge Ibaka on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“I was with the Clippers. One thing I respect so much about Ty Lue, he used to call me in the morning. ‘This week, I’m going with the young fellas.’ ‘OK, cool. Perfect. No problem,'”

Serge Ibaka on Tyronn Lue, Aug 3, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Bones Hyland on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Law Murray:Bones Hyland on LAC playing time:

“At the end of the day, it doesn't matter. I'm all about winning. Whether Coach Lue throws me in, and if he don't, I know Coach Lue has a great plan. So it's not going to throw me off. But if I get them reps, I'm going to do what I do.”

Bones Hyland on Tyronn Lue, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Bill Walton on Lawrence Frank, Tyronn Lue, Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Bill Walton:

“The culture he has built, Steve Ballmer, he bought the Clippers when they were a farce and now they are the authorial standard of excellence. You've got Lawrence Frank running the show, Ty Lue coaching it, you've got the players, it is just fantastic. We couldn't be happier, we couldn't be more proud, they've got the new arena coming. Yeah, the future, woah!”

Bill Walton on Lawrence Frank, Tyronn Lue, Steve Ballmer, Aug 20, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Law Murray:Frank on Lue:

“Great thing about Ty, his loyalty is to winning that game. Meaning whoever gives us the best chance to win a certain game, plays. It's not based on salary, it's not based on years in the league, it's not based on anything other than can you help us win the game.”

Lawrence Frank on Tyronn Lue, Apr 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Jason Kidd on the Clippers:

“Ty Lue's done an incredible job of keeping this team afloat. They've been hovering around .500 -- you never hear them complain...they have some talent over there, guys who can hurt you. We gotta be prepared.”

Jason Kidd on Tyronn Lue, Feb 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Paul George on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
But the Clippers said they were convinced Lue would have a plan for that.

“I think it’s special, just the relationship I have with T-Lue, and the relationship T-Lue has with every individual on this team in general,”

Paul George on Tyronn Lue, Jun 25, 2021. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Quin Snyder on Ty Lue's insistence that the Clippers up their physicality:

“I know they were really, really aggressive -- did a great job, frankly, of blocking us out. I thought they were really physical .. with Rudy on the boards, with switches.”

Quin Snyder on Tyronn Lue, Jun 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Nola's Coach Van Gundy on Clippers' Coach Ty Lue:

“He's been good from the beginning. ... that always amazes me. I don't know about his progression, he was so good right away. ... he's been good since the day he walked in.”

Stan Van Gundy on Tyronn Lue, Apr 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Steve Ballmer on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Steve Ballmer on a Zoom call introducing new Clippers coach Tyronn Lue:

“We are here as a consequence of a real extensive search process ... wanted to make sure we went out and met the best and brightest coaches from around the NBA ...”

Steve Ballmer on Tyronn Lue, Oct 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: James Posey on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:James Posey on possibly joining Ty Lue staff (after being on his staff w/ 2016 Cavs):

“Hell ya, I want to coach! I want to be a head coach someday. Hopefully things work out with T-Lue and he gets a head coach job out there. I'd love to join his staff.”

James Posey on Tyronn Lue, Oct 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Mark Jackson, Tyronn Lue, Sam Cassell
item.description:
“He has good players there — matter of fact, he has two great players there. He has a great foundation to start off of, and I look forward to seeing Brooklyn being one of the better teams next year. And Steve’s influence is gonna be a lot of that success, and I look for him to do big things there. Butif I was to be candid, you’ve got Mark Jackson out there. You’ve got Sam Cassell out there. You’ve got Tyronn Lue out there. You know what I’m saying? Proven guys, but Steve’s my guy. I’ll support him in anything he does,but it was also some — in my estimation — some deeper candidates out there that Brooklyn could have went with.”

Kevin Garnett on Mark Jackson, Tyronn Lue, Sam Cassell, Sep 10, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Mark Medina:Doc Rivers on Ty Lue:

“It's a joke that he's not a head coach, but it's to my advantage that he's not.”

Doc Rivers on Tyronn Lue, Sep 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Kevin Durant, Tyronn Lue, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Pierce said Tuesday’s on ESPN’s ‘The Jump.’

“Are they going to be a championship caliber team if you put Ty Lue in there and add (Kevin Durant) with Kyrie Irving? Yes. Can they do it? We have yet to see. Or it has yet to happen. But a great fit all across the board, I believe.”

Paul Pierce on Kevin Durant, Tyronn Lue, Kyrie Irving, Apr 21, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
said Jefferson, who is also an analyst for Nets games on YES Network.

“He can do all that stuff. He has a proven track record. So do I think T-Lue can coach this team? Do I think he can be successful? Yes.”

Richard Jefferson on Tyronn Lue, Apr 21, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Gregg Popovich, Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“T-Lue and Gregg Popovich are the two best X’s and O’s coaches that I’ve played for in my entire basketball career. From high school all the way up until I retired.”

Richard Jefferson on Gregg Popovich, Tyronn Lue, Apr 21, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“There are so many great young coaches out there who deserve an opportunity. T-Lue, to me, is the No. 1 young coach. He can coach,”

Richard Jefferson on Tyronn Lue, Apr 21, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tyronn Lue
item.description:
Farbod Esnaashari:Doc Rivers on the emotions of Tyronn Lue and the Clippers during Sunday's game:

“That game was just an awful game. For both teams. In the middle of the game I turned to Ty to ask a question, and he was crying. He literally couldn't function.”

Doc Rivers on Tyronn Lue, Jan 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.
